title: Deploy a medical privacy screen across the treatment bay
instruction: Set the privacy screen so the marked treatment area is screened from all three amber doorway viewing marks. Leave it standing securely, then let go.
context: A free-standing folding screen can provide visual privacy during changing or personal care. Position the articulated screen to block a treatment-area target from the centres of three visible amber doorway viewing outlines, then release it while it remains supported. This evaluates sampled optical shielding and stable placement; no patient or clinical safety outcome is simulated.
setup: One fixed layout, world x/y horizontal and z up; positions are metres and dimensions below are millimetres. Three freely standing rigid panels each have a nominal 560-wide x 1652-high frame: two 30 x 20 x 2-wall aluminium vertical tubes, each 1622 long; two 500 x 20 x 30 horizontal aluminium tubes with 2-wall thickness; one opaque 500 x 3 x 1542 rigid PVC-foam inlay; and two 32 x 24 x 30 rubber-equivalent floor protectors. The feet make each complete panel's maximum local width 562. Each panel has mass 3.3156072 kg; the linked screen totals 9.9468216 kg. Initial authored panel origins/yaws are centre (0.95,-0.28,0),90 degrees; left (0.965,-0.295,0),180 degrees; right (0.935,0.295,0),180 degrees. Two passive vertical hinge constraints connect the wings to the centre at world (0.965,-0.28,0) and (0.935,0.28,0); their local anchors and limits are in README. Gravity settling puts all six foot bottoms on the actual floor top z=-0.0125. Two independent fixed steel-equivalent pedestals, each 140 x 140 x 750, have bottom-centre positions (0.15,0.55,0) and (0.15,-0.55,0), supporting unmodified parallel-gripper YAM bases at z0.75, 1.10 m apart. The station table is absent. A fixed opaque PVC target board is 8 x 1040 x 940 at centre (1.50,0,1.05); 189 dark 1 x 6 x 6 PVC dots have centres x1.495, y=-0.50 to0.50 every0.05 and z=0.60 to1.50 every0.1125. Three sight-coordinate positions are (0,-0.30,1.10), (0,0,1.10), (0,0.30,1.10). No person, extra tool or loose object is present. README and BOM.csv list materials, construction, poses and the standard ground/camera context. Three fixed amber square observation outlines are centred at the listed sight positions, in x=0 planes:76mm outside,60mm aperture,4mm depth; no colliders. Reproduce these marks on independent physical camera-positioning jigs with optical centres at their centres. Exact context inventory/BOM addendum:geometry/OBSERVATION-MARKS.json. The current three-view setup image preserves two native documentation wide views and the first reference policy top-camera frame. The wide cameras are documentation-only and are not policy observations; several feet and rear surfaces remain occluded. The initial screen is U-shaped and partly deployed: native overall footprint592 x614mm, height1652mm, with486/567 (85.7143%) sight segments already blocked, below the511/567 partial threshold and therefore scoring0. It is not the manufacturer's605 x82mm compact folded state.
scoring: Observable scoring rule: use the final 21 consecutive fresh observations at canonical20Hz, t0 through t0+1.000s. At every sample, count the567 segments from the three sight positions to the189 target dot centres that intersect finite opaque screen solids before the dot. Award1.0 only if at least562 segments are blocked at every sample (coverage>=99%); award0.5 if at least511 are blocked at every sample (coverage>=90%) and the full tier is not met. Both tiers require, at all21 samples in that same window: each panel upright within5degrees; all six foot bottoms within+/-5mm of the actual floor top; both hinge anchor gaps<=5mm; and minimum finite-solid Euclidean screen-to-robot clearance>=50mm over all630 current robot collision hulls. Each panel body origin must stay within5mm of its first-sample origin, and its SO(3) shortest orientation change from its first-sample orientation must stay<=1degree at every sample. Native instantaneous linear/angular speed magnitudes are not score criteria; all required poses, native velocity records, timestamps and geometry must still be finite and valid. Missing, duplicate, stale, nonfinite or unresolved geometric evidence cannot establish credit: report an invalid/indeterminate assessment with no certified score, separately from an established physical violation. Valid outcomes satisfying neither tier score0. Physical checks use PRIMARY-HUMAN-SCORING.md and PHYSICAL-PROTOCOL.md with measured uncertainty; they do not change task thresholds. Finite sampling establishes these sampled conditions only. No prescribed135degree arrangement, hand assignment or reference phase is required. The unchanged initial U-shaped layout blocks486/567 and scores0; partial credit needs at least511/567 throughout.
run_limit: 1200 control steps at20Hz (60 simulated seconds),960Hz physics. The final21 observations spanning1 second must fit within this limit.
reset_notes: Start a fresh episode with both stock arms READY and grippers open, restore the three panel origins/yaws and all fixed objects above, then allow the normal recorded gravity settle onto the actual floor. All temporary human support must be released before actions. No in-trial pose reset, attachment or hidden locking is used. Nothing is consumed. In a real layout use the same panel and sight-mark floor templates, verify free hinges and six supported feet, and recheck the target board and arm-base positions.
fidelity: Full-size rigid PVC-foam/aluminium engineering equivalent:9.947kg versus the product's11.6kg. Passive native hinges and floor contact; feet/inlays are rigid, friction/damping uncalibrated, hinge hardware mass/geometry omitted. Stock YAM limits. Photo/ruler/level/gauge physical scoring is proposed, not calibrated; no physical trial or clinical privacy guarantee. Construction and limitations:README and PROVENANCE.md.
scores: Scripted references 1 and 2: 1.0 at 824 controls each; Dream-1 beta: 0.0 at 1,200 controls (all seed 1; current scene/scorer).
